drhp.business: The Company manufactures, supplies and services a comprehensive range of tyres for material handling applications such as forklifts, skid loaders, ground support equipment for airports, port trailers, agricultural implements, lawn and garden mowers, mining equipment, aerial work platform trucks and backhoe loaders. It has a renowned presence in both the domestic and global markets for more than two decades, selling under the brand names GRECKSTER, EMPOWER and AXIMO.
drhp.expansion: The Company is implementing a state-of-the-art compound mixing facility intended to cover the complete compound requirement of the present facility, including expansion of capacity in Solid and Pneumatic tyres. The Company is also expanding into manufacturing of additional products to provide end-to-end solutions, and plans to expand its wheel-segment offering by developing Multipiece rims beyond its current split-wheel focus. Separately, the Company is investing in SA Rubber Engineering Pty. Ltd. in South Africa to establish an export hub for tyres serving Africa, Europe and North America besides India, expected to complete on or before 30th November 2026.

litigation.note: The Related-Party Transactions section states there are no charges or satisfactions yet to be registered with the Registrar of Companies beyond the statutory period, except a compounding application filed for vehicle loans under the Companies Act, 2013.

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Notable increase in demand for Industrial, Agricultural and construction equipment globally, which directly influences demand for the company's tyres.
- Global economic slowdown, ongoing wars, and USA tariff threats pose risks to OHT manufacturing demand.
- The West Asia crisis is expected to significantly affect shipping costs and raise insurance costs, impacting external demand and economic stability.
- Revenue from exports was about 74.42% on a standalone basis for the year.
- Customer-focussed approach is stated to help ensure a sustained order book despite market challenges.

capex_expansion.title: Expansion (RHP)
capex_expansion.body: The Company is implementing a state-of-the-art compound mixing facility intended to cover the complete compound requirement of the present facility, including expansion of capacity in Solid and Pneumatic tyres. The Company is also expanding into manufacturing of additional products to provide end-to-end solutions, and plans to expand its wheel-segment offering by developing Multipiece rims beyond its current split-wheel focus. Separately, the Company is investing in SA Rubber Engineering Pty. Ltd. in South Africa to establish an export hub for tyres serving Africa, Europe and North America besides India, expected to complete on or before 30th November 2026.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- distribution: Owns exclusive retail outlets across India and globally under the 'Emerald Exclusive' banner — evidence: "Our unique Emerald Exclusive outlets across India and Globally epitomises our commitment to ensure this."
- integration: New state-of-the-art compound mixing facility intended to cover the company's complete compound requirement in-house, improving quality and product superiority — evidence: "the company is implementing a state of the art compound mixing facility that can provide the complete requirement of the company besides ensuring high integrity of the mixed compound." [planned]

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Strategically focusing on the Industrial Tyre segment of Off Highway Tyre (OHT), which the company views as resilient against downturns affecting mainstream automotive sectors.
- Strong R&D focus as the driving force for innovation, product differentiation and adaptation to market trends.
- Continued investment in the rubber/compound mixing facility to improve quality, optimise costs and support expansion of capacity in solid and pneumatic tyres.
- Customer-focussed approach aimed at meeting evolving customer demands to sustain the order book.
- Investment in SA Rubber Engineering Pty. Ltd. (South Africa) to expand presence in the high-potential South African market and establish an export hub for tyres serving Africa, Europe and North America besides India.
